title: The complete bipartite graph $K_{n,n}$ is 1-factorable
statement: For every natural number $n$, the complete bipartite graph $K_{n,n}$, whose two vertex classes each have $n$ vertices and whose edges join every vertex of one class to every vertex of the other, is $1$-factorable: its edge set decomposes into edge-disjoint $1$-factors (perfect matchings).
hypotheses_covered: n is a natural number (no further constraint)
replaced:
